g.title: MarieRank1Convo3 begins.
g.text: MarieRank1Convo3 begins.

g.title: j3472739767
g.text: Il y a un crâne volant ! Keksekça ?! There is a flying talking skull and everyone is going on about their days as if nothing is happening and I need someone to acknowledge the strangeness of their whole existence.

g.title: j453260979
g.text: That's just Necraloid. Well, a necraloid. It's complicated.

g.title: j2048476851
g.text: That is Necraloid. He's a Cephalon, he won't hurt you.

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j1514611121
g.text: Pardon, is it a name or an object ?

g.title: j105546188
g.text: I do not think him a threat ! He does not frighten me.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3097464712
g.text: I... don't rightly know.

g.title: j2186118916
g.text: Yes.

g.title: j3728967646
g.text: Indeed, I find him perfectly charming, if a bit unyielding in conversation. Not wholly unlike his living inspiration. But given the nature of my favored traveling companion, you can tell that does not bother me overmuch.

g.title: j1729308897
g.text: Firstly, of whose designs are these, "Necraloids ?" Of which they are a name and also, perhaps, a designation ?

g.title: j1003099151
g.text: I... do not understand. And how does Loid factor into this ?

g.title: j3436613977
g.text: No, what you might find grotesque in his visage, I assure you, is not the issue I currently have at hand.

g.title: j2466422486
g.text: Your Cardinal Dimanche. Entrati.

g.title: j982449894
g.text: Entrati made that one. But the concept of what they are - Cephalons - was invented by the Orokin.

g.title: j4216699178
g.text: I'm surprised the skull isn't off-putting for you.

g.title: j3363043601
g.text: I admit, taken out of context, he must be strange. But what in particular is upsetting?

g.title: j248951947
g.text: Excusez-moi, do you mean to imply that le Cardinal made a replicant flying skull servant in the likeness of his own companion, and named them thusly ?

g.title: j547699491
g.text: You know little of me, which is no fault of yours. I have spent much of my life tending to the dead and the places that they repose.

g.title: j695791392
g.text: I find myself curious as to why there is another face upon his back that resembles a child's scrawl.

g.title: j3579244146
g.text: Why are there not more of them, these necraloids, then ?

g.title: j3843456867
g.text: Indeed I have spent much of my life with them as my boon companions. They are keen to listen to my troubles of the day.

g.title: j2734695522
g.text: I inquired with Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid both, and neither wished to speak of it, they only told me a name. Otak. And it was with great sadness that they uttered it.

g.title: j1091092239
g.text: Maybe he realized how horrifying it is to make yourself a digital copy of your lover.

g.title: j1855046106
g.text: Maybe he only ever intended to make the one.

g.title: j1863317447
g.text: I'm not sure. Maybe he never got around to making more?

g.title: j4063127048
g.text: Boolean MarieGraveyard1 is now true.

g.title: j623866689
g.text: So here I am, speaking with you, in hopes you might be able to aid me.

g.title: j4204168779
g.text: Ou bien, a tribute to his love and respect, that he did not think this strange laboratory could continue to function without Monsieur Loid.

g.title: j3778393972
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3374259856
g.text: Imagine it, a school of flying skulls, all effortlessly and perfectly efficient !

g.title: j2462045356
g.text: Did you like looking after graveyards?

g.title: j1357088879
g.text: Did they ever respond?

g.title: j3718481847
g.text: Do you want to know about Otak? Or why you can't talk to him?

g.title: j3137489120
g.text: Otak is hard to explain...

g.title: j916385632
g.text: I would say that it makes for a strange kind of romantic gesture, but I'm hardly one to talk.

g.title: j2226496851
g.text: I wouldn't mind a necraloid buzzing around my place, honestly.

g.title: j2641804306
g.text: Tragic and beautiful, in its way, non ? A tribute to his love and respect, that he did not think this strange laboratory could continue to function without Monsieur Loid.

g.title: j2735816310
g.text: I'm glad there's only one of him, honestly. I don't think the world would be ready for that.

g.title: j1457784843
g.text: And mausoleums and cryptes, oh yes. But I do admit I preferred the outdoor spaces, though they were challenging for my chair to navigate. No more so than stairs, I fear.

g.title: j1600076105
g.text: Hah ! No, thankfully. Not until your "Necraloid" with such a morbid visage replied to me. If speaking to the dead is within the gifts of the Luminaries to bestow, it is not within my knowing.

g.title: j1380820342
g.text: I believe I wish to know both, in time, but I will let you decide where to begin. I do not know which is more important, après tout.

g.title: j3287217001
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j2433548487
g.text: And now I am intrigued, but that seems a story for another time. Cela dit...

g.title: j294851070
g.text: Then I have all certainty that you are likely beset by either a need for company or organization, or both. But that is a conversation for another time.

g.title: j1373065656
g.text: I think it had more to do with ensuring this place didn't fall apart at the seams, than anything else.

g.title: j1420384980
g.text: Indeed ! As am I. Which brings me to my next question.

g.title: j2427967412
g.text: Boolean MarieSerum1 is now true.

g.title: j3417754328
g.text: No, hearing spirits and voices is much more within the purview of my dear Lyon than I. Though I wonder if Monsieur Necraloid is not haunted as well, judging by the child's scrawl upon the back of his head.

g.title: j2573708091
g.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.

g.title: j3287217001->j2573708091
g.text: true

g.title: j3287217001->j2573708091
g.text: false

g.title: j2117405286
g.text: Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.

g.title: j3287217001->j2117405286
g.text: false

g.title: j576267845
g.text: And you very well may be right. The flying amalgam seems to be missing much of the real Monsieur Loid's raison d'être and nuance. Cela dit...

g.title: j766360596
g.text: I didn't know if it was appropriate to ask about whether or not your feet were changed by the serum...

g.title: j1129673253
g.text: Your chair?

g.title: j813615097
g.text: That is actually why I came here to speak to you, if you do not mind.

g.title: j681615635
g.text: Boolean MarieOtak1 is now true.

g.title: j2466793838
g.text: Boolean MarieFamily1 is now true.

g.title: j1137292593
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1183471322
g.text: I do not know what you would name it ? Un fauteuil roulant, or... perhaps a term I deeply dislike, un fauteuil pour invalide.

g.title: j1249797575
g.text: Par les Luminaires... please, go on.

g.title: j3773465689
g.text: Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!

g.title: j1275240273
g.text: Oh ! Oh, you poor thing. Imagine you, sitting there, wondering if I had mes pieds taken from me by le Cardinal ! Non, non, non - nothing of the sort.

g.title: j2029094060
g.text: Like what we perch in now, to sit at these little adorable devices to communicate. But with wheels upon the sides, to traverse. A chair with wheels, if you will.

g.title: j1601795073
g.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.

g.title: j139306309
g.text: His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.

g.title: j3657036996
g.text: Sol saw fit to place in my life the inconvenience of having been born with traditionally unwieldy feet. I could not walk.

g.title: j1855876278
g.text: You were an invalid before you became a protoframe?

g.title: j2055047610
g.text: We call them wheelchairs, believe it or not.

g.title: j1884577198
g.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful warframes and weapons we make.

g.title: j61250996
g.text: Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.

g.title: j2816015887
g.text: But it was simply that, an inconvenience.

g.title: j2635877570
g.text: Non. I very much was not.

g.title: j1139513595
g.text: Hah ! Oh, how I am sitting here laughing at myself for being the fool. Yes, I suppose you would call them wheelchairs, as they are chairs with wheels. Silly me.

g.title: j3560032767
g.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.

g.title: j3032412102
g.text: Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank(syndicate=EntratiSyndicate, syndicateRank=5)

g.title: j3813060886
g.text: Though, I do not miss having to push myself about. Nor does Lyon, I imagine. What freedom it is to fly !

g.title: j3350176257
g.text: Boolean MarieInvalid is now true.

g.title: j1119768546
g.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.

g.title: j1708019399
g.text: She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.

g.title: j3032412102->j1708019399
g.text: true

g.title: j2362593335
g.text: Check boolean MarieSyndicateMaxRank

g.title: j3032412102->j2362593335
g.text: false

g.title: j3945513838
g.text: I try to think of disabilities as things that change us. They limit us in some ways, yes, but they can give us strengths that others don't have.

g.title: j856576096
g.text: You never thought of your condition as a problem?

g.title: j3969338082
g.text: Did you know the protoframe serum would do this to you?

g.title: j2046849009
g.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.

g.title: j4141801606
g.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?

g.title: j2362593335->j1708019399
g.text: true

g.title: j320669504
g.text: She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.

g.title: j2362593335->j320669504
g.text: false

g.title: j1640296011
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2839086474
g.text: I never saw the point in bemoaning it. I certainly relish the ability to fetch objects from high shelves without aid, I will tell you that.

g.title: j2406915448
g.text: Oui, le Cardinal told Lyon and I all that would come of taking the sérums that changed our forms. We knew what it would do.

g.title: j2611416834
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j282741540
g.text: I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.

g.title: j1584553328
g.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?

g.title: j3708535526
g.text: Boolean MarieSecretPower is now true.

g.title: j416752662
g.text: Ce qui est fait est fait. I could not pray to Sol for a miracle, when so many were hurting more around me, when so many were of greater need. The Luminaries had already given me so much.

g.title: j3879875290
g.text: But like all things, I took mine in joy, and Lyon took his... oh, I fear as if I am telling on him and I should not.

g.title: j3798614590
g.text: Pauvre petit...

g.title: j1940583158
g.text: While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...

g.title: j3749549173
g.text: It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.

g.title: j3843907754
g.text: Oui ! You understand. I knew the world from another point of view. My arms were stronger. I am more patient. I know what it means to enjoy the moment.

g.title: j447098606
g.text: I must go. Thank you for this wonderful diversion.

g.title: j1864515055
g.text: It's all right. Don't tell me anything more than you're comfortable with.

g.title: j55150927
g.text: Please, keep going. I'm having a hard time getting through to him.

g.title: j4163710607
g.text: So, he was transferred to the main necraloid - the only Necraloid that remains - and is... well? It's hard to explain.

g.title: j411513092
g.text: I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?

g.title: j2802334988
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3725751063
g.text: When I reach my destination, I bask in the elegance of it. I do not scurry about like a beetle with a billion little legs.

g.title: j3583117186
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1439324624
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3844835639
g.text: I just wish we could fix him, honestly. Bring back the real Otak.

g.title: j4097928282
g.text: He makes me smile. He's funny, but it hides something tragic and broken.

g.title: j2450181658
g.text: Sadly, he's not fixable. And I think he grates on a lot of nerves.

g.title: j2103093387
g.text: You're right. I wish there was something we could do.

g.title: j872679365
g.text: It's not really my decision to make.

g.title: j2083848355
g.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.

g.title: j3400945841
g.text: Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.

g.title: j1158479167
g.text: I simply wish my dear Lyon could see the world in such a way as you. That all inconveniences may be a secret power, as you say.

g.title: j4287022074
g.text: I appreciate your kindness, Drifter. I will simply leave it at this, as to not overstep any imposition I may be placing upon you -

g.title: j2297188772
g.text: You are not alone in that, Drifter. Lyon is like family to me, and still sometimes I wonder if I know him any more than the statues of saints in the cathedral.

g.title: j1303866413
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j1822077294
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j466123574
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j107713462
g.text: Add 1 to Family counter

g.title: j2011238501
g.text: I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.

g.title: j2072653542
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3981678617
g.text: Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.

g.title: j135398195
g.text: Oh, I fear as if I am telling on him and I should not.

g.title: j1274520092
g.text: - Lyon paints the world in a crimson brush, whatever his outward demeanor may seem to belie. I am sorry he still does not speak to you. I am urging him to do so...

g.title: j873274315
g.text: Check boolean MarieLyonSuffering1

g.title: j2744978285
g.text: I know the compulsion you feel. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.

g.title: j2046025044
g.text: I know how you feel. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.

g.title: j315722524
g.text: Yes, I... know of a similar situation. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.

g.title: j3751589455
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j4261536068
g.text: I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.

g.title: j550015347
g.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.

g.title: j4018475200
g.text: I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.

g.title: j2934729504
g.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.

g.title: j1402156127
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonSuffering1 is now true.

g.title: j2546431673
g.text: You have been clever already to sniff out that Lyon holds a deep and painful burden in his heart. One that he feels he alone must carry.

g.title: j873274315->j2546431673
g.text: true

g.title: j4286777302
g.text: Lyon holds a deep and painful burden in his heart. One that he feels he alone must carry.

g.title: j873274315->j4286777302
g.text: false

g.title: j1123121321
g.text: À la revoyure.

g.title: j2046947882
g.text: Perhaps there is ! I would not give up hope. We must understand the root illness, if we are to treat it, non ?

g.title: j973000694
g.text: That we hide some great and terrible sin.

g.title: j1748716494
g.text: Add 1 to Family counter

g.title: j3487276276
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2579321067
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonSuffering2 is now true.

g.title: j953005488
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonSuffering1 is now true.

g.title: j2887142223
g.text: And it is that sin that must be forgiven.

g.title: j2424770783
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j284299010
g.text: I am sorry he still does not speak to you. I am urging him to do so...

g.title: j1792008943
g.text: Thank you, you have given me much to think on. À la revoyure.

g.title: j3568119798
g.text: Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.

g.title: j1262240750
g.text: I worry his compulsion to paint all the world with a crimson brush will be his undoing.

g.title: j1801102587
g.text: I must go. Merci pour cette merveilleuse distraction.
